description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
